items.title: Anthropic opens Claude AI text detection to regulators, media, fact-checkers, and others
items.summary: Anthropic is launching an API that lets regulators, media outlets, and researchers check whether text carries Claude's digital watermark. The EU AI Act now requires invisible watermarks in AI-generated text. Critics warn the technology could hurt text quality and create transparency problems where contracts ban AI use. The article Anthropic opens Claude AI text detection to regulators, media, fact-checkers, and others appeared first on The Decoder .

Prompt-level instructions and reviewer agents do not close this, because author and reviewer share the same blind spots. A team of researchers […] The post Researchers from Princeton, Ant Group and Stanford Introduce AQuA: A Two-Part Agentic Framework for Autonomous Factor Discovery and Model Development in Quantitative Finance appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.title: Google's election AI Overviews are opaque, rely on few sources, and sometimes take sides
items.summary: Using access granted under the EU's Digital Services Act, the German advocacy group AlgorithmWatch ran 4,480 election-related search queries on Google and analyzed the AI Overviews that came back. Google showed the overviews inconsistently and leaned on a small pool of sources, chief among them its own platform YouTube. Whether earlier safeguards against AI answers on election questions still apply, Google left open. The article Google's election AI Overviews are opaque, rely on few sources, and sometimes take sides appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 德國倡導組織AlgorithmWatch利用歐盟《數位服務法》授予的存取許可權，在Google平臺上進行了4480次與選舉相關的搜尋查詢，並分析了返回的AI概覽。 Google平臺顯示的概覽並不一致，且依賴少量資訊來源，其中最主要的是其自身的YouTube平臺。 Google平臺並未明確說明先前針對AI在選舉議題上作答的保障措施是否仍然有效。文章《Google's選舉AI概覽晦澀難懂、資訊來源有限且有時帶有傾向性》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items.title: ChatGPT、Reddit及Roblox被納入歐盟《數位服務法》規範
items.summary: 歐盟執委會（European Commission，EC）週一（8/31）宣佈，將ChatGPT納入《數位服務法》（Digital Services Act，DSA）超大型線上搜尋引擎（Very Large Online Search Engine，VLOSE）名單，Reddit與Roblox則被列為超大型線上平臺（Very Large Online Platform，VLOP），即日起適用DSA最嚴格規範，須於四個月內、即2027年1月前完成合規。

items.summary: 當AI打破漏洞修補節奏，過往資安團隊尚有餘裕應對的漏洞修補時程，如今正被大幅壓縮，如何在漏洞被發現或遭AI加速利用之前重新調整應對策略，已成為產業界迫切需要解決的課題，最近FIRST國際資安應變組織宣佈，將於9月23日至25日召開VulnOptiCON 2026，將原本的Vuln4Cast研討會更名並擴大舉辦，不僅將會期拉長為3日，議程主軸也從原本以漏洞預測技術為核心，擴大納入漏洞追蹤、CVE計畫前景，以及AI如何改變漏洞發現及利用等議題，以涵蓋更廣泛的漏洞生態系統主題。

items.title: Why MCP servers are becoming AI’s newest attack surface
items.summary: As AI adoption gathers pace, so does the evolution of the infrastructure that supports it. New standards and connectors keep appearing, and the ones that catch on spread through the ecosystem within months rather than years. That speed strengthens what AI can do, but makes it very difficult for security teams to maintain sufficient protections. […] The post Why MCP servers are becoming AI’s newest attack surface appeared first on AI News .
items.summary_zh: 隨著人工智慧的普及，支撐其發展的基礎設施也加速演進。新的標準和連接器層出不窮，那些被廣泛接受的方案往往只需幾個月而非幾年就能在整個生態系統中傳播開來。這種快速發展增強了人工智慧的能力，但也使得安全團隊難以維持足夠的防護。 […] 這篇文章《為什麼 MCP 伺服器正成為人工智慧最新的攻擊面》最初發表於 AI News。

items.title: Gradium AI Releases New Default TTS Model: 81.0% Hard-Case Pass Rate at 216 ms Time-to-First-Audio
items.summary: Speed and accuracy usually pull against each other in text-to-speech. Gradium AI's new default model reports both: an 81.0% human-rated pass rate on 500 hard sentences across five languages, at 216 ms P50 time-to-first-audio on Coval. The evaluation set is open on Hugging Face under CC BY 4.0. The post Gradium AI Releases New Default TTS Model: 81.0% Hard-Case Pass Rate at 216 ms Time-to-First-Audio appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 在文字轉語音領域，速度和準確度通常難以兼顧。 Gradium AI 的全新預設模型卻兼顧了這兩點：在五種語言的 500 個複雜句子上，其人工評分通過率高達 81.0%，Coval 測試的 P50 首次音訊播放時間僅為 216 毫秒。此評估資料集已在 Hugging Face 上開源，並遵循 CC BY 4.0 授權協議。本文最初發佈於 MarkTechPost，標題為「Gradium AI 發布全新預設 TTS 模型：複雜句子通過率高達 81.0%，首次音訊播放時間僅 216 毫秒」。

items.title: 勒索軟體Aurora濫用Cursor AI從事攻擊活動
items.summary: 資安公司CloudSEK與TRM Labs聯手，揭露勒索軟體Aurora（Aur0ra）的攻擊活動，他們根據駭客錯誤配置的伺服器，發現攻擊工具、AI輔助的攻擊規畫，以及與受害者對贖金進行談判的介面。該組織從今年4月開始積極活動，截至7月已有9個國家、超過20家企業組織受害，駭客取得其中17家網域層級的互動存取權限，有4家被列入Aurora的資料外洩網站。

items.title: Claude Fable 5.1 made me a really nice animated pelican
items.summary: Today is Claude Fable (and Mythos) 5.1 day . Anthropic say that Fable 5.1 "sets a new standard for coding, knowledge work, and long-running problem-solving tasks". Their announcement spends a notable amount of time on scientific research, boasting of a 52.6% score on the brand new Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 benchmark (first announced on August 27th ), up from 24.7% for Fable 5, 29.0% for Opus 5 and 22.4% for GPT-5.6 Sol. Other benchmarks show slightly improved scores, but none as impressive as the Science one. But how well can it pelican? Back in July I wrote about how I was losing faith in the pelican benchmark - its connection to how good the models were at other tasks didn't seem to hold as strongly as it did back in 2025 . The most interesting insights I get from it now are comparisons within model families, and particularly comparisons for the same prompt at different reasoning effort levels. Fable 5.1 has five reasoning levels: low, medium, high, xhigh, max - and no option to turn off reasoning entirely. I fixed an issue in llm-anthropic which caused reasoning traces not to be correctly recorded, then ran some prompts. Here's the full set of pelicans for all of the reasoning levels, each with the full reasoning transcript. I'll replicate them here: Low and medium, both without reasoning? Next, a bit of a mystery. This is what I got for effort low : The transcript doesn't show any summarized reasoning tokens, and the output token count is 1,998. With Claude that output token count includes reasoning tokens. items.summary_zh: 今天是 Claude Fable（以及 Mythos）5.1 版本發布日。 Anthropic 聲稱 Fable 5.1「為編碼、知識工作和長時間運行的問題解決任務樹立了新的標竿」。他們的公告用了大量篇幅介紹科學研究，並自豪地宣稱其在全新的 Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 基準測試（於 8 月 27 日首次發布）中取得了 52.6% 的分數，高於 Fable 5 的 24.7%、Opus 5 的 29.0% 和 Fable 5 的 1其他基準測試的分數略有提高，但沒有一項能像科學基準測試那樣令人印象深刻。但是，它的表現究竟如何呢？早在 7 月份，我就寫過我對 Pelican 基準測試失去信心——它與模型在其他任務上的表現之間的關聯性似乎不如 2025 年時那麼強了。現在我從中獲得的最有趣的見解是模型家族內部的比較，特別是同一提示在不同推理難度下的比較。 Fable 5.1 有五個推理難度：低、中、高、超高和最高——而且沒有完全關閉推理的選項。我修復了 llm-anthropic 中的一個問題，該問題導致推理軌跡無法正確記錄，然後運行了一些提示。以下是所有推理難度下的完整鵜鶘圖集，每個圖集都包含完整的推理記錄。我將在這裡復現它們：低難度和中難度，都沒有推理？接下來，有點神祕。這是我在低難度下得到的結果：記錄中沒有顯示任何總結的推理標記，輸出標記數為 1,998。而 Claude 的輸出標記數包含推理標記。耗時 23.8 秒，成本為 10.017 美分。我提高了這個值。 GPT-5.6 Sol

items.title: Codex bundles LibreOffice
items.summary: I was poking around in my ~/.cache/ folder using OmniDiskSweeper when I spotted something interesting. The OpenAI Codex desktop app (since rebranded to just ChatGPT) has 1.7GB of stuff in there in a folder called codex-primary-runtime , including a full Python installation, a full Node.js installation, and native binaries for Poppler , git, and the LibreOffice open source office suite (which forked from OpenOffice.org in 2010): The ~/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/plugins/openai-primary-runtime/plugins/documents folder includes skills which tell Codex how to find and use those binaries. Tags: codex , generative-ai , openai , ai , llms , openoffice , open-source
items.summary_zh: 當我用 OmniDiskSweeper 在我的 ~/.cache/ 資料夾裡閒逛時，發現了一些有趣的東西。 OpenAI Codex 桌面應用程式（現已更名為 ChatGPT）在名為 codex-primary-runtime 的資料夾中佔用了 1.7GB 的空間，其中包括完整的 Python 安裝、完整的 Node.js 安裝，以及 Poppler、git 和 LibreOffice 開源檔案~/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/plugins/openai-primary-runtime/plugins/documents 資料夾包含一些技能，這些技能告訴 Codex 如何尋找和使用這些二進位檔案。標籤：codex、generative-ai、openai、ai、llms、openoffice、開源

items.title: Alibaba says Qwen3.8-Max leads open-weight models on commerce agent benchmark
items.summary: The Accio team's state-based benchmark reports Qwen3.8-Max completing 56 tasks through Accio, 47 through OpenClaw and 53 through Pi; Alibaba calls it the strongest overall open-weight result.

items_ai.title: Google's election AI Overviews are opaque, rely on few sources, and sometimes take sides
items_ai.summary: Using access granted under the EU's Digital Services Act, the German advocacy group AlgorithmWatch ran 4,480 election-related search queries on Google and analyzed the AI Overviews that came back. Google showed the overviews inconsistently and leaned on a small pool of sources, chief among them its own platform YouTube. Whether earlier safeguards against AI answers on election questions still apply, Google left open. The article Google's election AI Overviews are opaque, rely on few sources, and sometimes take sides appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 德國倡導組織AlgorithmWatch利用歐盟《數位服務法》授予的存取許可權，在Google平臺上進行了4480次與選舉相關的搜尋查詢，並分析了返回的AI概覽。 Google平臺顯示的概覽並不一致，且依賴少量資訊來源，其中最主要的是其自身的YouTube平臺。 Google平臺並未明確說明先前針對AI在選舉議題上作答的保障措施是否仍然有效。文章《Google's選舉AI概覽晦澀難懂、資訊來源有限且有時帶有傾向性》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_ai.title: ChatGPT、Reddit及Roblox被納入歐盟《數位服務法》規範
items_ai.summary: 歐盟執委會（European Commission，EC）週一（8/31）宣佈，將ChatGPT納入《數位服務法》（Digital Services Act，DSA）超大型線上搜尋引擎（Very Large Online Search Engine，VLOSE）名單，Reddit與Roblox則被列為超大型線上平臺（Very Large Online Platform，VLOP），即日起適用DSA最嚴格規範，須於四個月內、即2027年1月前完成合規。

items_ai.title: Why MCP servers are becoming AI’s newest attack surface
items_ai.summary: As AI adoption gathers pace, so does the evolution of the infrastructure that supports it. New standards and connectors keep appearing, and the ones that catch on spread through the ecosystem within months rather than years. That speed strengthens what AI can do, but makes it very difficult for security teams to maintain sufficient protections. […] The post Why MCP servers are becoming AI’s newest attack surface appeared first on AI News .
items_ai.summary_zh: 隨著人工智慧的普及，支撐其發展的基礎設施也加速演進。新的標準和連接器層出不窮，那些被廣泛接受的方案往往只需幾個月而非幾年就能在整個生態系統中傳播開來。這種快速發展增強了人工智慧的能力，但也使得安全團隊難以維持足夠的防護。 […] 這篇文章《為什麼 MCP 伺服器正成為人工智慧最新的攻擊面》最初發表於 AI News。

items_ai.title: Gradium AI Releases New Default TTS Model: 81.0% Hard-Case Pass Rate at 216 ms Time-to-First-Audio
items_ai.summary: Speed and accuracy usually pull against each other in text-to-speech. Gradium AI's new default model reports both: an 81.0% human-rated pass rate on 500 hard sentences across five languages, at 216 ms P50 time-to-first-audio on Coval. The evaluation set is open on Hugging Face under CC BY 4.0. The post Gradium AI Releases New Default TTS Model: 81.0% Hard-Case Pass Rate at 216 ms Time-to-First-Audio appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: 在文字轉語音領域，速度和準確度通常難以兼顧。 Gradium AI 的全新預設模型卻兼顧了這兩點：在五種語言的 500 個複雜句子上，其人工評分通過率高達 81.0%，Coval 測試的 P50 首次音訊播放時間僅為 216 毫秒。此評估資料集已在 Hugging Face 上開源，並遵循 CC BY 4.0 授權協議。本文最初發佈於 MarkTechPost，標題為「Gradium AI 發布全新預設 TTS 模型：複雜句子通過率高達 81.0%，首次音訊播放時間僅 216 毫秒」。

items_ai.title: Claude Fable 5.1 made me a really nice animated pelican
items_ai.summary: Today is Claude Fable (and Mythos) 5.1 day . Anthropic say that Fable 5.1 "sets a new standard for coding, knowledge work, and long-running problem-solving tasks". Their announcement spends a notable amount of time on scientific research, boasting of a 52.6% score on the brand new Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 benchmark (first announced on August 27th ), up from 24.7% for Fable 5, 29.0% for Opus 5 and 22.4% for GPT-5.6 Sol. Other benchmarks show slightly improved scores, but none as impressive as the Science one. But how well can it pelican? Back in July I wrote about how I was losing faith in the pelican benchmark - its connection to how good the models were at other tasks didn't seem to hold as strongly as it did back in 2025 . The most interesting insights I get from it now are comparisons within model families, and particularly comparisons for the same prompt at different reasoning effort levels. Fable 5.1 has five reasoning levels: low, medium, high, xhigh, max - and no option to turn off reasoning entirely. I fixed an issue in llm-anthropic which caused reasoning traces not to be correctly recorded, then ran some prompts. Here's the full set of pelicans for all of the reasoning levels, each with the full reasoning transcript. I'll replicate them here: Low and medium, both without reasoning? Next, a bit of a mystery. This is what I got for effort low : The transcript doesn't show any summarized reasoning tokens, and the output token count is 1,998. With Claude that output token count includes reasoning tokens. It took 23.8 seconds and cost 10.017 cents . I bumped that up
items_ai.summary_zh: 今天是 Claude Fable（以及 Mythos）5.1 版本發布日。 Anthropic 聲稱 Fable 5.1「為編碼、知識工作和長時間運行的問題解決任務樹立了新的標竿」。他們的公告用了大量篇幅介紹科學研究，並自豪地宣稱其在全新的 Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 基準測試（於 8 月 27 日首次發布）中取得了 52.6% 的分數，高於 Fable 5 的 24.7%、Opus 5 的 29.0% 和 Fable 5 的 1其他基準測試的分數略有提高，但沒有一項能像科學基準測試那樣令人印象深刻。但是，它的表現究竟如何呢？早在 7 月份，我就寫過我對 Pelican 基準測試失去信心——它與模型在其他任務上的表現之間的關聯性似乎不如 2025 年時那麼強了。現在我從中獲得的最有趣的見解是模型家族內部的比較，特別是同一提示在不同推理難度下的比較。 Fable 5.1 有五個推理難度：低、中、高、超高和最高——而且沒有完全關閉推理的選項。我修復了 llm-anthropic 中的一個問題，該問題導致推理軌跡無法正確記錄，然後運行了一些提示。以下是所有推理難度下的完整鵜鶘圖集，每個圖集都包含完整的推理記錄。我將在這裡復現它們：低難度和中難度，都沒有推理？接下來，有點神祕。這是我在低難度下得到的結果：記錄中沒有顯示任何總結的推理標記，輸出標記數為 1,998。而 Claude 的輸出標記數包含推理標記。耗時 23.8 秒，成本為 10.017 美分。我提高了這個值。 GPT-5.6 Sol

items_ai.title: Codex bundles LibreOffice
items_ai.summary: I was poking around in my ~/.cache/ folder using OmniDiskSweeper when I spotted something interesting. The OpenAI Codex desktop app (since rebranded to just ChatGPT) has 1.7GB of stuff in there in a folder called codex-primary-runtime , including a full Python installation, a full Node.js installation, and native binaries for Poppler , git, and the LibreOffice open source office suite (which forked from OpenOffice.org in 2010): The ~/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/plugins/openai-primary-runtime/plugins/documents folder includes skills which tell Codex how to find and use those binaries. Tags: codex , generative-ai , openai , ai , llms , openoffice , open-source
items_ai.summary_zh: 當我用 OmniDiskSweeper 在我的 ~/.cache/ 資料夾裡閒逛時，發現了一些有趣的東西。 OpenAI Codex 桌面應用程式（現已更名為 ChatGPT）在名為 codex-primary-runtime 的資料夾中佔用了 1.7GB 的空間，其中包括完整的 Python 安裝、完整的 Node.js 安裝，以及 Poppler、git 和 LibreOffice 開源檔案~/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/plugins/openai-primary-runtime/plugins/documents 資料夾包含一些技能，這些技能告訴 Codex 如何尋找和使用這些二進位檔案。標籤：codex、generative-ai、openai、ai、llms、openoffice、開源
